ينتهجوا (form VII)
# يَنْتَهِجُوا (yantahijū) /jan.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# يُنْتَهَجُوا (yuntahajū) /jun.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
